summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FitTrack app with new water tracking, weight tracking, and reports features. All backend APIs working perfectly (21/21 tests passed). Frontend functionality fully operational with successful integration testing. New features: Water tracker with bottle visualization and quick-add buttons, Weight tracker with upsert functionality, Reports tab with expandable rows and period selection (Week/Month/Year). All existing features continue to work correctly.
passed_tests: AI food analysis (POST /api/food/analyze) with OpenAI integration

NEW: Weight retrieval by date and latest (GET /api/weight)
NEW: Reports API (GET /api/reports) with week/month/year periods
Summary endpoint (GET /api/summary) now includes total_water_ml and weight_kg
Water tracker with bottle SVG visualization (3L capacity, light-medium blue)
Custom water ml input and add functionality
Weight tracker showing current weight and input for new weight
Reports tab with Week/Month/Year period selector
Report rows expandable showing full macro breakdown, water, weight, training
All existing features still working (food entry, training log, macro circles, daily goals)
Frontend-backend integration for all new and existing data flows
